title: ID0424045-DC/Si-D/DK[qntu3k] - DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
description:
March 24 we noticed that the charger was in error with the error:
DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
This is an error that have occurred on two times earlier on the same charger and 8 times on other D400 chargers, we went to the site March 25. With measurements of the PT1000 sensors in the cable we found that the sensors in DC+ was broken.
The cable was replaced and the charger is working again.
No further actions needs to be done.
